title: The Fish's Eye
style_lock: Premium high-quality charming painted comic / Amar Chitra mythology; warm cream-saffron-gold hour; refined linework
style_master_ref: mood: cream-saffron-gold comic (do not attach Ep01 Drona figure plate)
frame: Ornate lotus carved wooden frame on every plate

apparatus.target: Live fish swimming in a circular ornamental pool set into the palace ground/floor
apparatus.mirror: Large ornamental circular mirror with gold frame mounted high under the palace ceiling — used only for aiming sight
apparatus.mount: Ceiling mirror fixed high under roof (large disc scale); no fish aquarium
apparatus.height: Mirror at true ceiling height top of hall; pool on the ground

aim_geometry.eyes: Look UP into the ceiling mirror (sees the fish reflected)
aim_geometry.arrow: Aim DOWN at the real fish in the ground pool — hit the eye
forbidden: Looking only at the pool without the mirror

apparatus.task: Hit the eye of the fish in the ground pool while aiming by looking into the ceiling mirror
forbidden: Glass aquarium / fish tank on the ceiling
Fish hanging dry on a pole
Women standing giant-sized on the court floor in durbar
Maids instead of princesses on balconies

draupadi.face: Young woman, warm brown skin, large dark eyes, soft brows, small bindi
draupadi.hair: Long black wavy hair, gold maang tikka + small crown
draupadi.costume: Deep red silk sari with gold border, gold jewelry, veil optional

princess.face: Young royal women, comic painted style
princess.costume: Rich silk saris, crowns — princesses only, never maids

arjuna_brahmin.face: Young man, oval face, dark eyes, thin dark mustache, calm focus
arjuna_brahmin.hair: Black curly topknot, no peacock, no jeweled crown
arjuna_brahmin.costume: Plain cream-white brahmin dhoti and cloth

arjuna_revealed.hair: Same topknot or light diadem, no peacock
arjuna_revealed.costume: White with optional soft gold accents

king_suitor.face: Adult warrior princes, comic line weight

king_drupada.face: Mature king, regal mustache and beard
king_drupada.costume: Royal white and gold on throne

plates.beat_text: In the court of King Drupada, suitors gather for Draupadi’s swayamvara.
must_show: Premium high-quality painted comic Amar Chitra durbar
King on center throne; princes/suitors ONLY on the hall floor seated both sides — equal natural human scale
ALL women and princesses ONLY on upper balconies left and right — none standing on the court floor
Princesses behind curtains/jali, shyly peering out
No giant women, no maids, no fish apparatus
must_not_show: Women standing on the court floor among princes
Giant princesses in the hall aisle
plates.prompt: Premium high-quality painted comic Amar Chitra regal Indian palace durbar. Eye-level balanced perspective, ALL figures equal natural human scale — no giants. CENTER: King Drupada on golden throne. HALL FLOOR ONLY: adult suitor princes seated in neat rows left and right — NO women on the floor. UPPER BALCONIES left and right only: Draupadi and other PRINCESSES in rich silk saris and jewelry behind heavy sheer curtains, shyly peering through gaps — not on railings, not standing in the court. Ornate lotus frame, cream-saffron-gold light. No fish, no mirror apparatus. Polished refined linework.

plates.beat_text: The test is set: a mirror high above; the fish waits in the pool. Hit its eye by looking only into the mirror.
must_show: Premium painted comic quality
LARGE circular ornamental gold-framed MIRROR high under the palace ceiling top center
Circular ground pool with live fish swimming in the water
Contest bow on floor pedestal beside pool
Mirror reflects the pool/fish; no aquarium
plates.prompt: Premium high-quality painted comic hall. LARGE circular ornamental gold-framed MIRROR fixed high under the ceiling (top center, wide disc). On the ground: circular ornamental pool with a golden fish swimming in the water. Mirror above can show the fish. Contest bow on a stone pedestal on dry floor. No aquarium, no fish tank on ceiling. Tall palace, cream-saffron-gold light, lotus frame, refined Amar Chitra quality.

plates.beat_text: Prince after prince fails. The great bow will not yield to pride alone.
must_show: Premium painted comic quality
Princes fail with bow on dry floor
LARGE ceiling mirror high under roof
Ground pool with fish swimming
Same apparatus as challenge
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic. Adult princes fail to string the contest bow on the hall floor. Behind: LARGE gold-framed circular MIRROR high on the ceiling; circular ground pool with swimming fish. No aquarium. Lotus frame, refined quality.

plates.beat_text: Draupadi waits with the garland, calm as the challenge grows heavier.
must_show: Premium painted comic portrait of Draupadi with garland
Royal princess quality, no maid
plates.prompt: Premium high-quality painted comic medium portrait of Princess Draupadi in deep red gold sari, long black hair, holding flower garland, calm. Soft palace arches. Lotus frame. Amar Chitra refined quality, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Then a young brahmin steps forward — quiet, steady. None yet know him as Arjuna.
must_show: Premium quality
Young brahmin Arjuna white dhoti topknot mustache reaches for bow
LARGE ceiling mirror high under roof
Ground pool with fish
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic. Young brahmin (black topknot, thin mustache, white dhoti) reaches for contest bow on pedestal. Hall shows LARGE gold-framed ceiling MIRROR high under roof and ground pool with swimming fish. No peacock, no aquarium. Lotus frame, refined quality.

plates.beat_text: He strings the bow, looks into the high mirror, and finds the eye in the pool.
must_show: Premium high-quality painted comic
Arjuna on LEFT dry floor BESIDE the pool — never in the water
LARGE circular gold-framed MIRROR high under ceiling top center
Ground pool with fish swimming — real target
Eyes looking UP into the ceiling mirror
Bow drawn, arrow aimed DOWN at the fish eye in the pool
must_not_show: Shooting upward at a tank of fish
plates.prompt: Premium high-quality painted comic Amar Chitra. Arjuna LEFT on dry stone floor beside the circular ground pool (never in water), white dhoti, topknot, mustache. LARGE ornamental gold-framed circular MIRROR high under ceiling top center. Fish swims in the ground pool. AIM GEOMETRY: his eyes look UP into the ceiling mirror; his bow is drawn with arrow aimed DOWN at the fish eye in the pool. Mirror reflects the fish. Refined polished quality, lotus frame. No aquarium.

plates.beat_text: The arrow flies. The fish in the pool is struck. The court falls silent — then roars.
must_show: Premium high-quality painted comic
Arjuna on left side dry floor
Arrow from archer's left side hits the fish eye IN THE GROUND POOL
LARGE ceiling mirror still high above
Splash in pool where fish is hit
must_not_show: Arrow from opposite side of Arjuna
plates.prompt: Premium high-quality painted comic. Arjuna LEFT celebrating. LARGE gold-framed circular MIRROR high under the ceiling. Circular ground pool: arrow from Arjuna's left has struck the fish eye in the pool — splash. No fish hanging above. Same-side arrow path. Refined Amar Chitra quality, lotus frame.

plates.beat_text: Draupadi places the garland on his neck. The prize is won by skill, not boast.
must_show: Premium quality
Same Draupadi and Arjuna faces, garland moment
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic. Draupadi places garland on Arjuna (white dhoti, mustache, topknot, no peacock). Soft palace, warm light, lotus frame, refined quality.

plates.beat_text: Once more Arjuna proves the lesson of the garden: see only what must be hit.
must_show: Premium quality closing plate
Arjuna and Draupadi together with garland
LARGE ceiling mirror and ground pool with fish still in hall for continuity
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic closing gold plate. Arjuna and Draupadi after victory. Behind: LARGE ceiling gold-framed MIRROR and ground pool (fish continuity). No aquarium. Warm cream-saffron-gold, lotus frame, refined quality.
